_note: Restores the two real Bank of America Customized Cash rules that were lost when an incorrect hardcoded special case was removed: the shared quarterly cap, and the fact that 6% is a first-year promo rather than the standing rate. Cap labels are phrased with 'combined with' so normalizeCapGroup puts both rows in one shared bucket.

patches._why: 6% is a first-year bonus on top of the standing 3%; storing it as the permanent rate overstates the card for everyone past their first anniversary. The $2,500/quarter cap is shared with the grocery row and was enforced nowhere after the hardcode was deleted.

rewardRuleNotes: Issuer merchant coding and current product terms control whether a purchase qualifies for the listed bonus category.
New accounts earn 6% in the choice category for the first year, then 3%. This app uses the standing 3% rate.
The 3% choice category and the 2% grocery/wholesale-club rate share one $2,500 combined cap per quarter; spend beyond it earns 1%.
Preferred Rewards members earn 25-75% more than the rates shown.

rename.to: Choice Category (up to $2,500/quarter combined with groceries and wholesale clubs)
